description_en: Updates the association between an entity and a benefit package. You can use this operation to bind a benefit package to a user
description_zh: 更新实体和权益包关联，可用于给用户绑定权益包
kebab_example: aliyun pds update-identity-to-benefit-pkg-mapping --identity-type user --identity-id user123 --benefit-pkg-id 40cb7794c9294 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateIdentityToBenefitPkgMapping

parameters.help_en: The quantity of benefit packages. This parameter takes effect only for resource-based benefit packages. This parameter is optional. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
权益包数量

对资源类权益包生效，非必填参数，默认为1
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the benefit package
parameters.name: benefit_pkg_id

parameters.help_en: The expiration timestamp of the benefit package. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. By default, the benefit package never expires
parameters.help_zh:
权益包超期时间的时间戳，格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒起至现在的毫秒数

默认永不过期
parameters.name: expire_time

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the entity. To manage user benefits, set this parameter to user_id
parameters.help_zh:
实体的唯一标识

管理用户权益时，传user_id
parameters.name: identity_id

parameters.help_en: The entity type. To manage user benefits, set this parameter to user
parameters.help_zh:
实体的类型
管理用户权益，传user
parameters.name: identity_type

v1_parameters.help_en: The domain ID. This ID uniquely identifies a domain and serves as the domain identifier in the service endpoint {domain_id}.api.aliyunpds.com
v1_parameters.help_zh: 域 ID，唯一标识一个域（Domain），作为业务访问地址 {domain_id}.api.aliyunpds.com 中的域标识
v1_parameters.name: domain_id
